page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g9ae.12xlarge is a general-purpose cloud instance built on the x86_64 architecture and managed by the KVM hypervisor. The hardware profile features dedicated AMD EPYC 9T95 processors clocked at 2.25 GHz, providing 48 virtual cores. Memory capacity is provisioned at 192.0 GB, establishing a standard 1:4 vCPU-to-memory distribution of 4.0 GB per virtual core. Hardware acceleration is absent, with zero GPUs included on the platform.

Storage and networking architecture reflects a disaggregated model. The instance includes no bundled local storage, meaning that operating system files, application binaries, and transactional data must be hosted on attached network block storage. Networking capabilities provide a baseline throughput of 25 Gbps. Complimentary public IPv4 addresses are not provisioned with the instance.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the configuration avoids the overhead of specialized hardware accelerators and onboard solid-state disks, directing resource allocation strictly into compute density, memory capacity, and standard network fabric. The requirement for external storage volumes represents a key operational tradeoff, making I/O performance contingent on remote storage provisioning. The instance is suited for multi-tier enterprise web applications, intermediate database engines, CI/CD compilation pipelines, and container orchestration clusters.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g9ae.12xlarge is a general-purpose instance powered by AMD EPYC 9T95 processors utilizing the x86_64 architecture. Managed under the KVM hypervisor, it features 48 dedicated virtual CPUs clocked at 2.25 GHz alongside 192.0 GB of memory, delivering a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. The instance is not equipped with discrete GPUs or bundled local storage, which makes persistent operations dependent on network-attached storage volumes. Network connectivity is supported by a 25 Gbps baseline bandwidth profile, while public IPv4 addresses are not included by default. With dedicated CPU allocation and balanced memory density, the instance offers cost-efficient scaling for compute and memory demands without the premium associated with GPU or high-speed local disk hardware. It is functionally configured for large enterprise web applications, backend services, CI/CD build environments, and containerized microservice deployments.
